Method of Attack: Out-of-bounds write via manipulated HTTP header size in httpboot.c
Executing privileged code before OS boot, bypassing kernel and OS security mechanisms
Impacted Systems: Linux distributions using Shim (Red Hat, Debian, Ubuntu, SUSE)
Attack Vector: Man-in-the-middle (MiTM) attack intercepting HTTP boot traffic
Local attacker modifying EFI Variables or EFI partition using live Linux USB
Network attacker using PXE to load compromised shim bootloader
Indicators of Compromise: Vulnerable Shim software hashes in UEFI Secure Boot DBX
